A Culinary Celebration for Hispanic Heritage Month

For Hispanic Heritage Month this year, we are tracing the cultural and culinary impact of chiles across Latin America. As a member of the Capsicum plant family, chiles are an incredibly diverse ingredient used across the world, with varieties ranging in geography, cuisine, uses, spice level, color, and more.
